project_type: Laravel 12 monolith with Blade templating and MySQL
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: run `php artisan test` to verify no regressions. Export routes must be accessible via GET and return PDF (Content-Type: application/pdf) or Excel (Content-Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet). Manual test: visit /back/water-levels?zone_id=1&export=pdf to verify filters are respected.
snapshot_or_generated_files: PDF and Excel files are generated dynamically in export methods; no committed snapshots needed.
environment_constraints: DomPDF requires freetype/fontconfig (usually present on dev systems). Excel export via PhpSpreadsheet (part of maatwebsite/excel). Use temporary disk for file generation if needed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns: use dependency injection, maintain consistent naming (snake_case for routes, camelCase for methods), use Illuminate\Http\Response for file downloads, add query parameters to preserve filter state.
key_patterns: Controllers use request()->integer() and request()->string() for filters; models use query builders with when() for conditional filtering; views pass filter state via route parameters; all filters are available in index() method.
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers/Back/ — controller layer; app/Models/Drought/ — Eloquent models; app/Services/ — business logic; app/Exports/ — (to be created) Excel export classes; resources/views/back/drought/ — Blade templates with exports/ subdirectory for PDF views; routes/web.php — route definitions
